model.name: YOLO26n
model.graph_boundary: six raw detection heads, decode + NMS on host

input.note: test_640.mp4 (640x640, 30 FPS, 394 frames), derived from a 3840x2160 traffic clip; all three devices ran this same file.

decode.implementation: common/postprocess_common.py + common/postprocess_yolo26.py (shared by all three runners)

timing.note: device_benchmark_total_fps / _ms: the single-stream inference-only figure for this client (34.88 FPS / 28.67 ms), printed on the clip's banner as 'infer only'. python_infer_only_fps (32.925): the mean of this run's own inference calls over 394 frames. pipeline_without_io: the rknnlite call plus host decode and NMS (42.49 ms); it does not include the frame read and letterbox, which read_letterbox_infer_decode covers (46.11 ms) - the Hailo-8 record's pipeline figure includes both, so the two columns are not defined identically. python_end_to_end_fps: the annotated pass, including drawing and MP4 writing.
